summary: Nutrien Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with a news release announcing a regular quarterly dividend of US$0.55 per share, payable July 17, 2026 to holders of record June 30, 2026. The filing provides details on currency election and direct deposit options. No special situation is involved; it is a routine dividend declaration with no change in payout policy, no strategic event, and no transaction. The 6-K is the foreign private issuer equivalent of a U.S. Form 8-K for a material event, but a standard quarterly dividend is not a material special situation. No action, recommendation, or unusual terms are present.
